banks.description: Gas supplies in the order the blender lists them; bank numbers in the result count from 1. Default: unlimited air, oxygen and helium.

cylinder_size.description: A cylinder bank's water volume in litres (metric) or rated ft³ at rated_pressure (imperial), given with pressure.

helium_pct.description: Helium % of this supply: 100 for helium, or a premixed bank. Default 0.

oxygen_pct.description: Oxygen % of this supply: 21 air, 100 oxygen, 0 helium, 32 a nitrox bank.

pressure.description: A cylinder bank's gauge pressure now (bar or psi), given with cylinder_size. Omit both for an unlimited supply such as a compressor.

rated_pressure.description: Imperial only: the psi the bank's ft³ is rated at. Default 3000.

current.description: The cylinder now: analysed mix, gauge pressure and size (default AL80 size).

cylinder_size.description: Metric: water volume of ONE cylinder in litres, the number stamped on the neck. Imperial: rated capacity in ft³ at rated_pressure (an AL80 is 77.4). Default: the preset's, else an AL80 (11.1 L).

oxygen_pct.description: Oxygen % of the gas in the cylinder now, as analysed, 0 to 100. Air is 21; an empty cylinder is 21 at pressure 0.

preset.description: A common cylinder instead of cylinder_size, as in plan_dive: al80, al40, al63, hp80, hp100, hp120, lp85, s80, single_10l, single_12l, single_15l, twin_10l, twin_12l, twin_15l, stage_11l, stage_7l, o2_3l, dil_3l. twin_ presets are a manifolded pair.

pressure.description: Gauge pressure now (bar or psi, per units), 0 to 500 bar (7252 psi).

rated_pressure.description: Imperial only: the psi the capacity is rated at. Default: the preset's, else 3000. Ignored on metric.

twinset.description: true for two cylinders on a manifold, filled or breathed together: doubles the volume. Default: the preset's, else false.

environment.description: Altitude and temperatures. Default sea level, 20 °C, fill at ambient.

altitude.description: Altitude (m or ft, per units), 0 to 10000 m (32800 ft). Lowers the surface pressure the math adds to gauge readings. Default 0.

ambient_temperature.description: Temperature the cylinder cools to (°C or °F, per units), -50 to 100 °C. Default 20 °C (68 °F).

fill_temperature.description: Gas temperature right after filling (°C or °F). Above ambient, the plan fills to a hot pressure that settles to the target. Default: ambient.

max_plans.description: Plans to return, 1 to 5: the best one plus alternatives. Default 3.

target.description: The mix and settled pressure to reach.

oxygen_pct.description: Target oxygen %, 0 to 100 (EANx32 is 32, trimix 21/35 is 21).

pressure.description: Target gauge pressure once the cylinder has cooled (bar or psi, per units).

units.description: metric (m, bar, L, °C) or imperial (ft, psi, ft³, °F): the unit system for every value in and out. Default metric.

volume.description: Free gas drawn, L or ft³.

mix_result_additions.description: mix_result additions: every add step, in order.

mix_result_current.description: mix_result current: the cylinder after the last bleed.

partial_plan_steps.description: feasible false: the steps that run before the plan gets stuck.

bank.description: add: bank number from 1, in the order given.

bank_pressure_after.description: add from a finite bank: the bank gauge after.

bank_pressure_before.description: add from a finite bank: the bank gauge before.

kind.description: bleed down, add from a bank, or let the cylinder cool.

to_pressure.description: bleed and add: gauge pressure to stop at.

spoken_summary.description: A few plain sentences for a voice reply, ending with an offer: digits allowed, no symbols or notation.

steps.description: The best plan in order; empty when feasible is false.
